Text to a machine word and back: the t27a assembler

The last step turns a line of text into one 32-bit word. Type a line of t27a assembler and see the word, the line the disassembler prints for it, and which bits belong to which field.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/t27 specs/isa/t27a.t27 (t27 master 90e797659): every word, status and listing is assemble, assemble_status, listing_char, is_canonical or reassemble, and the field owners are found with opcode_of, dst_of, t27a_src1, t27a_src2, v3_of and t27a_imm, spliced in from specs/isa/ternary_encoding.t27 through use, fn bodies compiled to wasm (logic.js)
  • Course 12 of t27.ai, t27-compiler: lesson 25 opens this widget
